name: overtime-tracker-root
description: Overtime Tracker - Fazla Mesai Takip Sistemi

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const b = spawn('npm', ['start'], { cwd: 'backend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const f = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev', '--', '--host', '0.0.0.0'], { cwd: 'frontend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { b.kill(); f.kill(); process.exit(); });"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
